The report opens with a line naming the machine it ran from:

HOST: workstation                      Loss%   Snt   Last   Avg  Best  Wrst StDev

and the rows that follow are indented by two spaces. The same document
describes the settings report, which opens with

Settings for eno1:

and then lists a label and a value per line. Neither line is output on
its own; both are quoted here so a reader can recognise them.
